source.policy: Finite explicitly requested outskirts and mapped landscape, exact previous scope subtracted. New hero ownership replaces only exact overlaps; prior source packets and details are immutable. Source water/road vertices remain unsimplified; unavailable heights and flat terrain are labelled display estimates.
source.forestTreePolicy: Illustrative 42m sampling strictly within retained woodland, avoiding paths/water/buildings; not individual surveyed trees.
source.heroNavigationPolicy: Exact per-part footprints and vertical envelopes; retained source geometry for comparison. Open stadium pitch uses its measured ground profile.
